source_title: QUANTUM CONNECTIONS APPOINTS JOSUE "SWAE" PAGAN AS DIRECTOR OF LEARNING
source_excerpt:
Former financial-services L&D executive to lead coaching, onboarding and technology-enabled learning for the Safe Conversations methodology
DALLAS , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Quantum Connections, the Dallas-based relational skills organization founded by Harville Hendrix, Ph.D. and Helen LaKelly Hunt, Ph.D., has appointed Josue "Swae" Pagan as Director of Learning.
Pagan will lead Quantum Connections' learning and development strategy, working closely with the leadership team to build the coaching, onboarding, and technology-enabled learning experiences behind the Safe Conversations methodology across workplace and faith-based communities.
Pagan brings eight years of corporate Learning & Development experience, most recently as Vice President of Leadership Development & Enablement at a global financial institution. He specialized in instructional design, behavioral coaching program architecture, and large-scale onboarding systems. He built Coach University, a coaching certification initiative that strengthened how leaders developed and evaluated their people, and led an organization-wide rollout of large language model prompting workshops, helping thousands of employees adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
Dr. Jonathan Thorp, Chief Executive Officer of Quantum Connections said, "Swae and his passion to see others elevate themselves through masterful interactive learning makes him perfect for our team. He brings a commitment to excellence in further developing our learning curriculum and is paramount to our mission with a focus on modernization of delivery and content."
For Pagan, the role is a natural extension of a conviction he's carried through his career. "People over projects. That's the formula that gets the most out of business initiatives. Leaders who invest time into their people's side are the ones who see those projects succeed at a higher rate."
Pagan holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from Lee University. Outside of work, he prioritizes time with family, is an avid moviegoer, and has played the drums since he was four years old, playing regularly for his church service.
Quantum Connections, founded by renowned relationship experts Harville Hendrix, Ph.D., and Helen LaKelly Hunt, Ph.D., leverages over 40 years of expertise to provide individuals and organizations with invaluable relational competency skills rooted in neuro and quantum social sciences. Quantum Connections serves small businesses, large corporations, global faith communities, educational institutions, and community organizations, as well as individuals, couples, and families, offering live and on-demand training, coaching certification, and resources to foster authentic connections through effective communication and skill development.
